title: VanillaReborn+
description: overhauls every aspect of the game while staying true to vanilla.
body:
A smooth and _optimized_ Minecraft experience with better visuals, animations, sound and UI — **all while staying true to vanilla charm!**
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/R9_1AF1skP8" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

### Features:
**Optimization**
- better optimization

**Visuals**
- minecrafty textures (like in Actions&Stuff)
- shaders
- new particles

**Better Adventures**
- more vanila-like structures
- new vanilla-like mobs
- more advancements
- Realistic Mob Size
- Health Indicator (Mobs)
- Easy Anvil, Easy Magic

**UI Overhaul**
- title screen overhaul
- better UI
- Essentials Mod

**Better Sound Design**
- better sound and ambience
- more music
